blocks.text: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala saw her bid for Asian Games singles gold end in Thursday’s semifinals after a stunning 3-6, 6-3, 6-2 loss to China’s Xiyu Wang. Eala, the tournament’s top seed, skipped the China Open to play in Nagoya and was looking to become the first woman from the Philippines to win the Asian Games title. A gold would have guaranteed Eala a place in the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles.
